annotations.title: CLP Annex VIII UFI Code Checksum Validator & Poison Centre Dossier Ready Auditor

description:
[CLP Annex VIII UFI code checksum validator. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Validates 16-character Unique Formula Identifiers (UFI) under CLP Annex VIII using the ECHA Base-31 polynomial checksum algorithm for chemical mixture emergency health response.
Usage: Pass a UFI code to verify character validity, hyphenation, and mathematical checksum integrity.
Returns: JSON object with { ufiCodeFormatted: string, isValidFormat: boolean, isChecksumValid: boolean, payloadCharacteristics: object, pcnNotificationRequirements: object }.
